Verify if the spoon is physically plausible. Also, check if the 'drip' defies gravity or has inconsistent viscosity compared to the pooled sauce.

A spoon is suspended vertically above the plate, dripping thick, dark chocolate sauce onto a central mound of the same sauce. The sauce on the plate is decorated with artistic swirls and dots, resembling a stylized face or abstract design. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the glossy surface of the chocolate.
